commands.command: git diff -- README.md tests/test_readme.py && git status --short

sed -n '1,260p' README.md && printf '
--- tests/test_readme.py ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' tests/test_readme.py && printf '
--- files ---
' && rg --files -g '! .chongdae/**' | sort

rg -n '^##|site-build|post-type|Q-|`feed`|`patch-view`' README.md || true
git status --short -- README.md tests/test_readme.py
